_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Acceptance Test Plan
summary: The Acceptance Test Plan details the criteria, performance objectives, and list of tests to be performed by the contractor for acceptance tests on systems and equipment.
use_relationship:
The Acceptance Test Plan details the criteria, performance objectives and list of tests to be performed by the contractor for acceptance tests on systems and equipments.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to contracts requiring preparation of an acceptance test.

This DID supersede DI-QCIC-80553.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall contain the following:

children.title: Overview.
children.content: Consists of a brief description of the objectives of the acceptance test plan, including flow diagrams, milestones, personnel participation, and security requirements. This section shall include the following:

children.title: Flow diagram.
children.content: A functional description of the acceptance test program using a block diagram portrayal of the functions that must be met to satisfy the total acceptance program. Functions shall be numbered 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, etc...

children.title: Milestones.
children.content: Identifies the start and expected completion dates of each test to be performed.

children.title: Participation.
children.content: Identifies the Government and Contractor participation roles and responsibilities.

children.title: Security.
children.content: Identify and state briefly any security measures of guidelines to be observed.

children.title: Master test list.
children.content: Lists all test to be accomplished in the order they are to be performed. Separated listings for each location shall be provided. This listings shall be include the following:

children.title: Facility.
children.content: Location where the acceptance test is to be performed.

children.title: Item number.
children.content: Number for each piece of equipment or item, test will be performed.

children.title: Test description.
children.content: Name and brief description of test to be performed.

children.title: Parameters.
children.content: The number of cycles the test will be performed and selected parameters to be observed.

children.title: Equipment location.
children.content: Current location of equipment to be tested or used in the acceptance test.

children.title: Special tests.
children.content: Provides a list of special or unusual tests and examinations necessary to verify satisfactory equipment performance to specifications.

preparation_instructions.title: Equipment list.
preparation_instructions.content: The equipment list shall list all equipment to be used in the acceptance test. The listing shall include the following:

children.title: Special test equipment.
children.content: List all special test equipment required to be designed or constructed for use on the program by:

preparation_instructions.title: Validation procedure.
preparation_instructions.content: An overview of the procedures that the contractor will use to validate the test results.
